summary: Mana-stacker Mnemonic Ring: fractured mana cost efficiency (anchor), T1 flat mana, % mana essence, T1 intelligence, T1 cast speed, desecrated T1 rarity at 40% quality.

steps: Item level is not stated: 80 assumed (MCE needs 77+, T1 mana 75)
Buy a Mnemonic Ring with T1 mana cost efficiency (>= 23%), at most 4 mods, not fractured: 25-30 div; divine MCE to 26%

Dextral Crystallisation + Essence of the Abyss marks a suffix, Collarbone, Fracturing Orb 1 in 3 on the prefixes: hit on the 6th base ('usually within your first three'). Not costed: mana cost efficiency is not a planner mod, so the planner sees it as a fractured non-target anchor
Annul down to two mods, Chaos spam for a T1 suffix that isn't cast speed: T1 intelligence (chaos count not stated)
Sinistral Exaltation + Exalt, Sinistral Crystallisation + Essence of the Breach (removes accuracy, adds max quality)
Speed catalysts to 40%, Catalysing + Dextral Exaltation + Perfect Exalt: T1 cast speed first try
Dextral Necromancy + Ancient Collarbone, reveal with Abyssal Echoes: T1 rarity (reveal before whittling)
Neural catalysts to 40%, Catalysing + Perfect Exalt: T1 max mana first try; re-quality to 40%, Omen of Whittling + Chaos removes the quality mod
Sinistral Crystallisation + Perfect Essence of the Mind (50/50, won); Divine + Orb of the Blessed not costed
Stated: 'estimated costing craft being between 150 to 300 divs' (incl. the MCE base and fractures); sells ~400 div. Counts are this single, lucky run

market.source: creator at upload (NUiXXbrPS4E 0:18, 15:00): market 400-600, 'can sell for roughly about 400'; not a trade check

factCheck.notes: Fracture-phase source range 1:30-5:38 -> 1:24-6:26 (hit at 6:15); ilvl 80 marked inferred. Route and single-run counts match (cast speed and max mana first try, 6 fracture bases).
